monorepoScoping.position: The recursive tree at the pinned revision contains exactly one licence-like file: the repository-root LICENSE. There is no separate LICENSE, COPYING, or NOTICE under web/, and no per-directory licence header scheme was found. On the ordinary reading, a repository-root MIT LICENSE covers the whole repository, including the web/ subtree that this ingest takes. That reading is recorded explicitly here because the ingest is subtree-scoped while the grant is repository-scoped.
